skill.needleStorm.summary: Fires a fast bolt at the nearest enemy. Walls stop it.
skill.needleStorm.awakening: +{needles} needles in a fan, damage +{damage}%, pierce {pierce}. Each hit sends a shard into a nearby enemy for {shard}% damage.
skill.fanKnives.summary: Scatters thin knives in a fan ahead.
skill.fanKnives.awakening: +{knives} knives. They fly back and cut the enemies behind you too.
skill.chainSpark.summary: Strikes a bolt that leaps between enemies.
skill.chainSpark.awakening: +{jumps} jumps, damage +{damage}%. The last jump explodes and stuns for {stun} s.
skill.frostLine.summary: Draws a slowing cut toward the nearest enemy.
skill.frostLine.awakening: Width +{width}. The frost the cut leaves roots enemies for {root} s.
skill.orbitScythes.summary: Blades circling you keep grinding the enemies that come close.
skill.orbitScythes.awakening: Adds {blades} outer blades circling the other way.
skill.boneMortar.summary: Drops a heavy blast where enemies crowd the most.
skill.boneMortar.awakening: Blast radius +{radius}, damage +{damage}%. A {aftershock}% shockwave bursts once more at the centre.
skill.railSpear.summary: Fires a piercing line across the screen.
skill.railSpear.awakening: Width +{width}, damage +{damage}%. Fissures burst for {fissure}% along the rail's path.
skill.mirrorClone.summary: Afterimages on either side fire with you.
skill.mirrorClone.awakening: The clones fire +{shots} aimed shots, pierce +{pierce}. With Black Rail, they copy a rail {chance}% of the time for {railDamage}% damage.
skill.voidMine.summary: Leaves a mine field underfoot that pulls enemies in.
skill.voidMine.awakening: Radius +{radius}, duration +{duration}s. The field ends in an executing blast.
skill.blackSun.summary: Opens a pulling gravity well where enemies crowd.
skill.blackSun.awakening: Radius +{radius}, duration +{duration}s. Its collapse deals damage by max health and a long slow.
skill.ironFrame.awakening: Defence +{defense}, max health +{maxHp}. A hit raises a shield for {shield} s.
skill.magnetSigil.summary: Pulls in XP and coins from farther away.
skill.magnetSigil.awakening: Pickup range +{magnet}, coins +{coins}%. Every {pulse} s it pulls in the rewards on the map.
skill.paperWard.summary: Raises defence and the invulnerability after a hit.
skill.paperWard.awakening: Defence +{defense}. A hit bursts paper that pushes back enemies within {radius}.
skill.recoveryThread.summary: Raises health regeneration and pickup range.
skill.recoveryThread.awakening: Regeneration +{regen}, magnet +{magnet}. At full health it lashes out around you every {counter} s.
skill.coinFever.summary: Raises coin gain and attack speed together.
skill.coinFever.awakening: Picking up coins sends attack speed up {boost}% for {seconds} s.
skill.eclipseStep.summary: When threats close in, cuts through them in a flash of shadow.
skill.eclipseStep.awakening: Slash radius +{radius}. A black afterimage then sweeps the field again for {damage}% damage.
skill.executionMark.summary: Raises critical chance and damage to bosses.
skill.executionMark.awakening: Critical +{crit}%, boss damage +{boss}%. Deals up to {bonus}% extra damage to bosses low on health.
skill.mirrorClone.awakening.classic: With Black Rail, the clones copy a rail {chance}% of the time for {railDamage}% damage. Without the rail it does nothing.
bonus.overdrive.body: Your attack and attack speed upgrades for this run each go up a step at once, until the run ends.
bonus.overdrive.line: Offered when no skill is left to pick
bonus.coins.body: Gain coins at once. The amount grows with the stage and the round.
bonus.heal.body: Restores 50% of your max health at once.
bonus.heal.line: A reward to keep you going
objective.midBoss: Defeat the chapter {chapter} mid-boss · it enrages when time runs out
objective.finalBoss: Defeat the chapter {chapter} boss · it enrages when time runs out
objective.holdLine: hold the line against mid-size foes
objective.infinite: Defeat random bosses back to back
bonus.goal.hold: Hold the marked ground for {n} s
bonus.goal.terrain: Spend at most {n} s in hazards
objective.mod.rangedCap: Up to {n} ranged enemies at once

draft.hint.next: ★ Its awakening leads the next draft
draft.keys.keyboard: Keys 1–{count} pick · arrows move · Enter confirms
settle.damage.label: Damage share by skill
settle.practiceNote: Practice stages unlock nothing and pay 30% of the rewards.
settle.nextFromMenu: Start the next stage from stage select.
hud.summary.infinite: Endless mode. Time {time}. Score {score}. Bosses defeated {bosses}.
hud.summary.health: Health {hp} / {max}. Move with WASD, the arrow keys, a pointer, or a gamepad.
hud.summary.pause: Pause with P, Escape, or the gamepad Start button.
pause.title: Paused
pause.lead.keyboard: The run is paused. Continue with P or Escape.
pause.lead.pad: The run is paused. Continue with {pause} or {back}.
pause.healNote: Health added by an upgrade fills in over {seconds} s after you resume.
pause.coinNote: Settlement gold counts the coins you earned this stage, so spending them here costs you nothing.
pause.abandon.infinite: Give up now and the run is recorded and settled exactly as a defeat. Stop here?
pause.abandon.campaign: Give up now and the stage settles exactly as a defeat. Stop here?
controls.menu.keyboard: Arrows · Enter confirms · Escape goes back
controls.skills.keyboard: Every skill fires on its own
controls.skills.pad: Every skill fires on its own

save.text: Save text (an export, or the text to import)
save.copied: Copied to the clipboard. Paste it somewhere safe, such as a notes app.
save.copyManually: Copy all of the text above and keep it.
save.confirm: This replaces your progress with this save. Press again to import.
save.refuse.format: This is not an exported save. Paste all of it, from start to end.
save.refuse.save: The save is missing or damaged, so nothing was imported. Your data is unchanged.
save.refuse.future: This save comes from a newer version. Update the game, then import it.
save.refuse.storage: Could not save. Your data is unchanged.
fault.title: An error stopped the run
fault.body: An error came up during play, so the game paused itself. Try again to go back to the pause screen; going to the menu forfeits this stage's rewards.
reset.title: Reset your progress?
reset.body: Gold, account level, permanent upgrades, and unlocked stages go back to the start.
hint.move.keyboard: Move with WASD or the arrow keys. Attacks fire on their own.
hint.move.pad: Move with the {move}. Attacks fire on their own.
hint.xp: Collect the green ink shards to level up and pick skills.
hint.shop: You have coins. Pause with {pause} to buy upgrades.
hint.telegraph: Watch the orange warning the boss draws on the ground, and get out before it fills.
menu.chapterLocked: Clear stage 10 of the previous chapter
